"""Fixture for module_level_fastmcp: a bad module-level FastMCP() call next to a compliant one
built inside a function, as create_server() will do from G12 on."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("bad-module-level")


def create_server() -> FastMCP:
    """Compliant: the call lives inside a function body."""
    return FastMCP("good-inside-function")
